note: Every entry is a port that was actually run. status: stop = named errors remain; build = packaged build + mixin audit passed; load = the real client or server loaded it; behaviour = an assertion on the mod's own state passed in the game (a frame change or a reloaded save is not behaviour). A run proves only its own loader and the updates it crossed. Add an entry only with a receipt; remarked says when and why a status was lowered.

hops.detail: First port into the unobfuscated game, to a packaged build with the mixin audit passing in 66s. The tool resolved NeoForge 26.3.0.97, moved NeoGradle 7.0.185 to 7.1.39, Java 21 to 25 and archivesBaseName to base.archivesName, and compiled with no mapping at all. Rule families took 82 errors to 1: ResourceLocation to Identifier, GuiGraphics to GuiGraphicsExtractor, the GameRules and RenderType moves, InputConstants keys, HUD state on mc.gui.hud, and the tooltip extract/rename set. The last error is the removed debug-text event, which needs a new debug screen entry; that one file was written by hand and is marked in the tree. Next rung: load it in a real 26.3 client.

Three overlay lines inspected in the real client; a visual gate caught an invisible overlay that a passing build missed. Re-marked from behaviour to load on 2026-10-26: The overlay lines were read off a screenshot by a person and the gate was a frame-change percentage; no assertion on F3Nope's own state or text ran.

remarked.why: The overlay lines were read off a screenshot by a person and the gate was a frame-change percentage; no assertion on F3Nope's own state or text ran.

hops.detail: Backport of the untouched upstream snapshot; built, audited and loaded in the 1.21.5 client.

Port and backport. Behaviour asserted on 2026-10-26 by tools/tests/AppleSkinHudCheck.java in the real 1.21.6 client through modaccel eval: the health AppleSkin's HUD estimates a golden carrot restores (+12.000002) matched what natural regeneration really healed once the player ate it (+12.000001), within 0.01. With its slow-regeneration estimate broken on purpose (+1.5 instead of +1) the same check failed (+13.000002 against +12.000001). Re-marked to load earlier the same day because the inventory opening and save reload did not check AppleSkin; those are not counted.

remarked.why: Opening the inventory changes the frame and a save reloads at the same position with or without AppleSkin, so neither checks its behaviour. Nothing asserted AppleSkin's own state (its HUD overlay, saturation or tooltip values).

promoted.why: An assertion on AppleSkin's own HUD value passed in the real client, and failed with AppleSkin broken on purpose.

hops.detail: Guided debug HUD migration; the remaining changes are named rather than guessed.

Fresh copy of upstream 1bb67d4 ported by modaccel port --fix with no manual edits (154s, packaged build). Behaviour asserted on 2026-10-26 by tools/tests/ZombieAiCheck.java in the real 1.21.4 client (NeoForge 21.4.161) through modaccel eval: a zombie summoned by a command got the mod's own goals (ZombieEatFoodGoal, ZombieMountZombieHorseGoal, target goal ZombieHuntGoal) and its zombieapocalypseaddon_scaled tag, and once the mod's /zhunt command turned hunting on it targeted and hit a pig three blocks away, which a vanilla zombie never does. With EventHandler's goal injection removed on purpose the same check failed (no goals, no target). The server-check bot was not used: MCProtocolLib has no 1.21.4 release.

19 API errors repaired by rules, packaged metadata rewritten, jar loaded and its /za dashboard rendered in a real 1.21.4 world. Re-marked from behaviour to load on 2026-10-26: The /za dashboard was read off a screenshot by a person; no assertion on the mod's own state (its config, wave or registry values) ran.

remarked.why: The /za dashboard was read off a screenshot by a person; no assertion on the mod's own state (its config, wave or registry values) ran.

hops.detail: 38 reported errors reduced to 9 by rules; the rest is the 1.21.6 SavedData codec and owner/saddling API.

Hub router, three families in one command (1.21.1 -> hub 1.21.3 -> 1.21.4), fresh copy of upstream 1bb67d4. One map joined across 1.21.1, 1.21.2, 1.21.3 and 1.21.4; rules ran only on the updates their jump covers. 34 errors to 2 to 0, packaged build and mixin audit in 165s (warm Gradle and mapping caches, fresh project). ui-check loaded it in a real 1.21.4 client (NeoForge 21.4.161, 3 mods) in 34s. Behaviour not checked on this run.

Hub router (1.21.1 -> 1.21.3 -> 1.21.4 -> 1.21.5 -> 1.21.6), fresh copy of upstream 1bb67d4: 98 errors to 12 to 9 in 78s warm, the same counts as the one-jump path (--direct, 88s). The difference is the report: all 9 are placed on update 1.21.4 -> 1.21.5 by the joined map (SavedData.Factory and SavedData.save removed, OwnableEntity.getOwnerUUID, Saddleable.equipSaddle and Entity.isInWaterOrBubble removed, TamableAnimal.setOwnerUUID renamed).

Hub router across nine hops (1.21.1 -> 1.21.3 -> 1.21.4 -> 1.21.5 -> 1.21.8 -> 1.21.10 -> 1.21.11 -> 26.1.2 -> 26.2 -> 26.3), fresh copy: one map joined by intermediary ids to 1.21.11, then rules; 100+ errors to 69 in 140s warm. The one-jump path (identity map into 26.3) stops after two rounds at 100+ (93 listed). Of the 69: 4 placed on their update by owner, 24 by name in the 26.x step files, 35 by name only (owner differs, often a supertype such as Entity), 6 unplaced.
98 errors left in the 1.21.6 GUI rewrite; the port refuses to ship a build against the old game.

Five-minor jump. Loom 1.8 to 1.10 and Gradle 8.10 to 8.13 first, JEI dropped because upstream 1.21.6 has none. Mappings went through, then seven rules cleared 11 sites (Identifier.of/ofVanilla, food components, debug HUD), taking the error count from 62 to 51 with no new error. The rest is structural: render pipeline (texture colour and depth), the removed exhaustion getter, tooltip component methods, and payload records.

Upstream 1.20.1-fabric at c6751d6 ported by modaccel port --fix with nothing written by hand (590s, 28 rules, Loom 1.8 to 1.10.5, Gradle 8.10 to 8.12). The last four new-code changes became port features: an accessor mixin the port writes for the removed exhaustion getter and setter, helpers it adds for client game rules and for food effects on the consumable component, and the old channel-plus-buffer networking carried over as one payload type holding the same bytes (HungerManagerAccessor.java and ModaccelPacket.java are written by the port). Mixin then refused three mixins against 1.21.6; the port repaired them from Mixin's own messages (a moved class inside a target string, a target pinned to a gone descriptor, a handler missing the parameter its target gained) and Mixin applied all 8. Behaviour asserted on 2026-11-08 by tools/tests/AppleSkinHudCheck.java in the real 1.21.6 client: the health AppleSkin's HUD estimates a golden carrot restores (+12.000002) matched what natural regeneration really healed (+12.000001), within 0.01; with its slow-regeneration estimate broken on purpose the same check failed (+13.000002). The check first caught a wrong rule: getSaturationModifier() had been renamed to saturation(), which since 1.20.5 is the finished amount, and the estimate read +15.5.

Its own 26.3-fabric checkout compiled through the tool in 14s (Loom 1.17, Java 25, no mappings). The build path reaches the newest game; porting into 26.3 still needs a name bridge from yarn to the unobfuscated names.

Routed port with learned rules: 69 errors before, 50 after (130s / 123s). Five learned rules fired: entity type constants to EntityTypes (26.2), GameProfile.getName to name() (1.21.9), command and player permission levels (1.21.11), registry lookups (1.21.2). 26 errors went away; 7 that the missing names had hidden surfaced (EntityType.create and convertTo take more arguments now). Warm Gradle and mapping caches, fresh upstream copy each run; before = rules as of the hub router, after = plus the 38 rules learned from Stonecutter switches (bench/stonecutter_rules.py).

Routed port with learned rules: 9 errors before and after (126s / 84s), all on 1.21.4 -> 1.21.5 (SavedData factory, isInWaterOrBubble, owner UUID, saddle). The switches show those in one mod or none, so no rule was learned for them. Warm Gradle and mapping caches, fresh upstream copy each run; before = rules as of the hub router, after = plus the 38 rules learned from Stonecutter switches (bench/stonecutter_rules.py).

Untouched mod, neoforge-1.21.1 branch @d1e9c39, no third-party dependencies: 14 errors before and after (366s / 253s). No learned rule matched: its errors are the HUD layer API (LayeredDraw), float drawString, scroll bar position and RegistryAccess.registry, which the mined switches show in one mod or none. Warm Gradle and mapping caches, fresh upstream copy each run; before = rules as of the hub router, after = plus the 38 rules learned from Stonecutter switches (bench/stonecutter_rules.py).

Re-run through the router (Loom 1.10 and Gradle 8.13 by hand, JEI disabled as in step 7). Without help javac stops at one import, com.mojang.blaze3d.platform.GlStateManager, which moved to com.mojang.blaze3d.opengl in 1.21.5; --direct stops at the same 1, and so did step 7's first run, whose 61 came after that import was moved by hand. With the new glstatemanager-opengl rule the real count shows: 37 errors, 10 rules applied (87s), same with and without the learned Stonecutter rules (99s), which are mojmap-only. Left: render pipeline (setShaderColor x9, blend and depth state, texture ids), the exhaustion getter, food component effects, tooltip component, networking receivers. Warm Gradle and mapping caches, fresh copies.

Untouched mod, branch 1.21 @e2ca3d6: stopped before compiling. Build discovery fails on flywheel-neoforge-1.21.4:1.0.0-9, which does not exist; the mod compiles against Create, which has no 1.21.4 release. A real dependency blocker, but it is reported as a Gradle failure, not a named dependency blocker.

Untouched mod, branch 1.21 @8ae52f0: stopped before compiling. Its JEI coordinates are built from ${minecraft_version}, so the target step moves the name to jei-1.21.4-* but keeps version 19.64.0.453, which does not exist, and a selection to JEI 20.0.0.4 was not picked up. Tool gap: dependency setup does not follow property-built NeoForge coordinates.

Re-run with nothing done by hand, through modaccel port --fix (72s, warm caches). The build tools now follow the target: Loom 1.8-SNAPSHOT went to 1.10.5 because the target's Fabric API was built with Loom 1.10, and Gradle 8.10 to 8.12, the version Loom 1.10.5's published metadata asks for. The first build showed 69 errors; 22 rules took them to 11, including the whole render family (render type then pipeline first in drawTexture, shader colour into each draw call, blend and depth state, texture binds and views), the tooltip component's new size arguments, the empty text contents and canAlwaysEat. The 11 left are four changes that need new code, and the stopped port now names a repair guide for each: the removed hunger exhaustion getter (an accessor mixin), food effects moved to the consumable component, game rules only on the server world, and networking as payload records. Upstream's 1.21.6 also replaced the icons.png HUD textures with sprites, which a rule cannot restore.

Ported by modaccel port --fix with nothing written by hand: 26 rules, the removed debug-text event now among them (it becomes a registered debug screen entry), and NeoForge 26.3.0.101 with Java 25. Behaviour asserted on 2026-11-08 by tools/tests/AppleSkinHudCheck.java in the real 26.3 client through modaccel eval: the health AppleSkin's HUD estimates a golden carrot restores (+12.000002) matched what natural regeneration really healed (+12.000001), within 0.01. With its slow-regeneration estimate broken on purpose (+1.5 instead of +1) the same check failed (+13.000002 against +12.000001). Getting there needed one port fix: the project's Parchment parameter names for 1.21.5 were applied to the 26.3 game, which compiled Minecraft's packet bundler wrong and left every singleplayer world on its loading screen; Parchment now follows the target and is removed when it publishes none. The game's NeoForm setup takes about an hour on this PC when it is busy.

Upstream neoforge-1.21.1 branch at d1e9c39 ported by modaccel port --fix with nothing written by hand (165s cold on the boat Linux host, 37s with the game set up): 13 errors to 0 through eight new rules (NeoForge's GuiLayer for the removed LayeredDraw.Layer, scrollBarX, a widened override made public, the GUI_TEXT_HIGHLIGHT pipeline, RegistryAccess.lookup, and a helper for NeoForge's removed float drawString that keeps its end-x result) beside the 1.21.6 colour alpha rule. The build tools follow the target: NeoGradle 7.0.145 to 7.1.39 and Gradle 8.9 to 8.14; on 7.0.145 it compiled but stopped at launch with two ASM versions on the class path. Behaviour asserted on 2026-11-08 by tools/tests/NotesPinCheck.java in the real 1.21.6 client (NeoForge 21.6.20-beta, hidden on Xvfb with software OpenGL): holding Notes' key opened its notes screen, a note saved through its own code was read back from disk with the same text, and its pinned-note HUD layer drew that text in opaque white. With the pinned note drawn at alpha 0 on purpose the same check failed (the layer drew nothing).

Fresh copy of upstream 1bb67d4 ported by modaccel port --fix with nothing written by hand (30s; the game's NeoForm setup came from Notes' port, 0 steps run): the last 9 errors, all on update 1.21.4 -> 1.21.5, became rules and port features: SavedData.Factory to a SavedDataType whose codec wraps the mod's own NBT load and save, isInWaterOrBubble to isInWater, a helper that puts the saddle in its equipment slot with its equip sound, a helper for the owner's UUID from getOwnerReference, and an accessor mixin for the horse owner field that only setOwner(LivingEntity) sets. ZAA has no mixins, so the port adds zombieapocalypseaddon.modaccel.mixins.json and its [[mixins]] entry (undo removes both); Mixin applied the accessor against 1.21.6 (1 of 1) once its check reached NeoForge 21.6's renamed unit-test launch target. Behaviour asserted on 2026-11-08 by tools/tests/ZombieAiCheck.java in the real 1.21.6 client (hidden on Xvfb): a summoned zombie got the mod's goals (ZombieEatFoodGoal, ZombieMountZombieHorseGoal, ZombieHuntGoal) and scaling tag and targeted a pig; with EventHandler's goal injection removed on purpose the same check failed.
